_note: Chart notes shown in the (?) notes dialog. `indicators` maps an indicator Key (as in content/copy/measure-copy.csv) to a note shown on that chart. `general` holds site-wide caveats: `suppressed` is shown in the (?) dialog, expanded view and Details flyout of any chart with a suppressed value; Edit here — no code changes needed.

general.unreliable: Estimate may be unreliable because of small counts or sample size, so interpret with caution.
general.suppressed: To protect privacy, some very small values are suppressed (reported as 0).

indicators.age-distribution: NYC DOHMH population estimates, modified from US Census Bureau interpolated intercensal population estimates, 2000-2020. Updated September 2021.
indicators.race-ethnicity: White, Black, Asian and Other exclude Latino ethnicity. Latino is Hispanic or Latino of any race.
indicators.uninsured: Percentages may not sum to 100% due to rounding.
indicators.edu-college-degree-and-higher: Percentages may not sum to 100% due to rounding.
